labels.look: Cream, green monospace headlines 'EASY COME Easy Go', 'Time & Again' with typewriter and balloon icons, pole labels PROPORTIONAL / TYPEWRITER and THIN / BOLD, centred prose
labels.ux: Headlines animate between proportional and typewriter, thin and bold; dot moves between the labels; sticky trial/licensing bar
labels.learn: Write headlines whose meaning matches the change ('Easy come, easy go' while the width morphs): copy and animation tell one joke

labels.look: Near-black band, five thin white line sketches of the Hubot robot mascot from different angles, difference blend
labels.learn: Show the mascot sketches the companion font grew from: a brand character can be a typeface's origin story

labels.look: Black, purple outline 'ET' with green Bézier nodes and '0°' angle tags, white caption 'Flexible persistence' right
labels.learn: Tag the terminals with their angle (0°) to prove a construction rule holds across every slant

labels.variantDefinition: The same word repeated at several labelled stops along one axis (slant, weight, optical size), beside prose explaining what changes
labels.look: Royal blue, white serif 'Refrigerator' four times at SLNT 0, -2, -5, -8 with tiny value labels, prose column left
labels.ux: Sample words are editable; static stops
labels.learn: Pick a word that contains every letter that changes (f, e, a, i) and show it at fixed stops: progressive cursivity becomes legible

labels.variantDefinition: The variable designspace drawn as a plane or cube with a live position marker, driven by axis sliders beside a sample word
labels.look: Light grey ruled grid, axis readouts (WGHT 600, WDTH 75, SLNT -5), wireframe cube with red point, huge italic 'Metropolis', file-format notes below
labels.ux: Sliders for weight, width, slant, size, spacing move the point in the cube and restyle the editable word
labels.learn: Draw the designspace as a cube with a moving dot: visitors see where an instance sits among all axes at once

labels.look: Teal field, white cards per category (Uppercase, Lowercase, Small caps, Ligatures, Numerals, Punctuation, Icons) with tiny yellow tags
labels.learn: Category cards with colour tags let readers jump to the slice they care about (icons, small caps) without scanning a monolithic grid

labels.look: White, red-and-black branding for a fictional spa hotel: brochure, soap label, signs, kids menu, letterhead, open book
labels.learn: Invent one coherent client (a hotel) and brand its every touchpoint: range from signage to body text in one glance

labels.variantDefinition: One editable sample (word or pangram) on a calm field with a small set of axis and size sliders around it; the simplest tester
labels.look: Saturated blue, centred white 'Ship it', three thin sliders (weight, width, slant), cat/robot toggle, marquee 'USE THEM FLEX'EM FORK THEM' top and bottom
labels.ux: Editable word; weight/width/slant sliders; toggle swaps Mona Sans and Hubot Sans
labels.learn: A two-icon toggle between sibling fonts (cat vs robot) compares families with zero UI text

labels.look: Lavender, editable pangram in light sans, three axis sliders (Inktrap, Balloon, Curve) above, size/spacing/leading sliders right
labels.ux: Six sliders restyle the editable pangram live
labels.learn: Name custom axes by their visual effect (Balloon, Inktrap) so the sliders explain themselves
